general_information.Syllabus Name: International trade and Operations_Thương mại và vận hành quốc tế
general_information.Learning-Teaching Method: Lecturing,social constructivism, in-class practice, discussion, groupwork
general_information.Time Allocation: Study hour (150h) = 45h contact hours + 1h final exam + 104h self-study
general_information.StudentTasks: - Students must attend at least 80% of contact slots in order to be accepted to the final examination. - Student is responsible to do all exercises and assignments given by instructor in class or at home and submit on time - Use laptop in class for learning purposes
general_information.Tools: - Text book and other required reading materials - Internet - Edunext system (https://edunext.fpt.edu.vn/) - Vietnam's legal texts in press, information and communication sectors

learning_outcomes.CLO Details: Explain the fundamental economic theories of international trade to justify why and where goods move across the globe.
Analyze how international trade policies and the fragmentation of global value chains directly influence supply chain costs, routing decisions, and inventory management.
Apply appropriate Incoterms 2020 rules and fundamental international sales contract clauses to accurately allocate physical risk, freight costs, and legal responsibilities between buyers and sellers.
Evaluate various international payment methods to identify and mitigate financial and operational risks for both importers and exporters.
Interpret and cross-verify essential commercial, transport, and official documents to ensure regulatory compliance and facilitate physical cargo clearance.

assessments.Grading Guide: Individual assignments are graded on a scale of 0-10, precise to one digit after the decimal, which will be contingent upon their participation and fulfill the other's requirements of the lecturer (can be homework, inclass excercise...).
assessments.Note: Based on class attitudes and participation

assessments.Grading Guide: In-class conducted; 'The given question will focus on the main content of the related chapters.
assessments.Note: The lecturer is the one who decides the length of the test and number of questions

assessments.Knowledge and Skill: The question will cover the lectures, class discussions, activities, exercises, and textbook.
assessments.Note: Students are not allowed to use document/information in any form in exam room
